jobs.title: Research Scientist, Embodied AI
jobs.description: About Niantic Spatial We are building for the >80% of economic activity that happens beyond the reach of screens. AI has learned from the text, images and video online, but it still lacks an accurate understanding of physical space. That’s one of the biggest unsolved problems in AI, and it’s the one we’re solving at Niantic Spatial. We build spatial AI models and services so people and machines can reason, learn and act safely in the physical world. We turn camera imagery, video, sensor data and archives into accurate, AI-readable representations of real places that robots can train in and machines can use to know exactly where they are. In physical AI, mistakes have real consequences. That’s why we build AI grounded in measured reality, not guesswork, so the people and machines relying on it can trust it to get things right. Our team built some of the world’s most widely used maps. Now we’re building something bigger: a living, measured record of the real world that machines can query, learn from and use to understand how places change over time. If you want to help AI understand the world we actually live in, come build with us. About the Role Niantic Spatial makes the physical world computable, helping people and machines collaborate safely by aligning how they understand reality. One of the fundamental problems we're helping autonomy teams and engineers overcome is the sim-to-real gap for visual-spatial understanding. We're applying our team's decades of experience encoding the world precisely as it is at Google Maps, Google Earth, and Niantic Labs to build the scalable real-to-sim stack for embodied AI. Niantic Spatial's R&D Team in London is seeking a Research Scientist to push the frontiers of Spatial AI, advancing our Large Geospatial Model as a dedicated member of the Embodied AI group. jobs.title: DeFi Quant Trader Intern (Credit) - London
jobs.description: DeFi Quant Trader Intern (Credit) Since 2017, Keyrock has been a change-maker in digital assets. We're a global, remote-first team of 200+ people across 40+ nationalities, with hubs in Brussels, London, Paris and New York. We provide liquidity across 80+ centralized and decentralized exchanges - a position cemented by our Series C, led by SC Ventures. Today we run a full spectrum of capital markets businesses across centralized and on-chain venues: market making, high-frequency trading, options, OTC, DeFi trading desks, advisory, and asset management. We're building toward the agentic investment banking capabilities for the era of digital finance. A proprietary agentic layer runs the mechanics of the market, so our people can focus on the work code cannot do: the deal, the relationship, and the judgement. We're not just envisioning the future of finance - we're building it. About the Internship Program Our internship programme gives early-career talent the opportunity to build practical skills, contribute to meaningful projects and learn alongside experienced colleagues in digital finance. Typically lasting six months and based in our Brussels office (London possible), each internship includes hands-on experience, clear learning goals and dedicated guidance and regular feedback. We look for curiosity, relevant foundational skills, deep, active interest and passion for digital assets and the potential to grow exponentially with us - you don’t need to arrive with all the answers. Where performance, business needs and available opportunities align, an internship may lead to a permanent role, though this is not guaranteed. We are looking for 3-4 high-caliber Quantitative Analyst Interns to sit within our Strategic Market Making (HFT), Credit and Corporate Development desks/teams (see other openings on our career page for details). Application deadline: 30 November 2026 Start date: 1 March 2027 Selection process: Interview with Talent Acquisition representative Interview

jobs.title: hbo-stage Analyseren kwaliteit bouwvergunningen BAG
jobs.description: hbo- afstudeerstage, vanaf februari 2027 Ben jij die nieuwsgierige en enthousiaste student die graag in data duikt en op zoek gaat naar opvallende patronen en verbanden? Krijg jij energie van het ontrafelen van complexe vraagstukken, het ontdekken van inzichten en het vertalen van data naar betekenisvolle resultaten? Dit is jouw uitdaging Het CBS ontvangt maandelijks van de 342 gemeenten in Nederland informatie over verleende bouwvergunningen. Gemeenten leveren deze gegevens aan via enquêtes en registreren de bouwvergunningen daarnaast in de Basisregistratie Adressen en Gebouwen (BAG). Sinds 2025 publiceert het CBS de cijfers over bouwvergunningen op basis van de BAG. Er is echter een groot en toenemend verschil tussen de cijfers uit de BAG en de tellingen uit de enquêtes. Er is reeds onderzoek gedaan naar deze toenemende verschillen. Als stagiair ga je dit verder onderzoeken, door middel van een diepgaande analyse van de tijdigheid en kwaliteit van de registratie van gegevens in de BAG. Daarnaast verzamel je informatie over het registratieproces om beter inzicht te krijgen in hoe de BAG zich verhoudt tot de werkelijkheid. Je onderzoekt onder andere: Hoe lang wachten gemeenten met registraties? Worden registraties doorlopend geregistreerd, of opgespaard en in korte tijd geregistreerd in de BAG? Verandert de kwaliteit en tijdigheid door de tijd heen? Om deze vragen te beantwoorden duik je in een grote database, waar je met behulp van SQL en R of Python trends gaat waarnemen, data visualiseert, en samenvattingen maakt. Daarnaast verzamel je informatie over het registratieproces, en hoe dit is geïmplementeerd bij gemeenten. Voor deze taak is al eerder onderzoek gedaan, en is er ook al meer informatie beschikbaar. Je verzamelt deze resultaten in een rapport met een overzicht van de huidige stand van zaken. Dit is jouw stageplek bij CBS Den Haag Ons team bestaat uit 24 enthousiaste collega’s, die met veel passie en plezier werken aan statistische informatie over vastgoed

Vind je het daarnaast leuk om verantwoordelijkheid te nemen, werkzaamheden te coördineren en samen met je team iedere dag het beste resultaat neer te zetten? Dan is deze functie iets voor jou! Als Logistiek Teamleider bij BERG ben jij een belangrijke schakel in onze logistieke operatie. Je stuurt dagelijks een team van Logistiek Medewerkers aan, bewaakt de voortgang en zorgt ervoor dat de goederenstroom soepel, veilig en efficiënt verloopt. Vanuit onze passie voor actief buitenspelen werken we iedere dag samen aan één doel: The outdoors is yours! Unterstützung aller Projektbeteiligten und Gewährleistung eines reibungslosen, termingerechten und budgetkonformen Projektablaufs. Überwachung des Projektfortschritts, Sicherstellung der Einhaltung rechtlicher und technischer Standards sowie enge Zusammenarbeit mit den zuständigen Behörden. Entwicklung umweltfreundlicher Lösungen unter Beachtung höchster Sicherheits- und Nachhaltigkeitsstandards sowie Integration moderner Technologien in die Projekte. Aufstiegsmöglichkeiten sind vorhanden. Qualifikation Das bringst Du mit: Kenntnisse in technischem oder naturwissenschaftlichem Arbeiten Du besitzt echte

Deshalb suchen wir für unseren kaufmännischen Bereich einen Teamleiter Property & Asset Management (m/w/d), der ein Team von rund vier Mitarbeitenden führt und diese Entwicklung aktiv mitgestaltet. Télécom Paris, école de l’IMT (Institut Mines-Télécom) et membre fondateur de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris, est une grande école du top 6 des écoles d’ingénieurs généralistes françaises. La Raison d’Être de Télécom Paris est de former, imaginer et entreprendre pour concevoir des modèles, des technologies et des solutions numériques au service d’une société et d’une économie respectueuses de l’humain et de son environnement. Nous recherchons notre futur(e) post-doctorant(e) en IA agentique correcte par construction (SoS) pour rejoindre le département INFRES de Télécom Paris. Contexte scientifique : les cadres de vérification existants supposent généralement des modèles finis et précisément définis, dont les actions et les relations de transition sont connues. Ces hypothèses sont difficiles à maintenir dans les systèmes modernes d’IA agentique, où les actions peuvent être générées dynamiquement, les environnements peuvent évoluer et les informations sur le système peuvent être incomplètes. Le projet Sound or Silent (SoS) vise à combler cette lacune en étudiant une nouvelle approche d’IA agentique correcte par construction. L’idée centrale consiste à intégrer le raisonnement stratégique et la vérification formelle directement au processus décisionnel des agents autonomes. Au lieu de vérifier un agent uniquement après son développement ou de surveiller son comportement après l’exécution, SoS étudie la possibilité de produire des actions formellement certifiées conformes à une spécification donnée. Selon cette approche, une action candidate n’est exécutée que s’il est établi qu’elle appartient à une stratégie garantissant les propriétés requises. Si une telle garantie ne peut être établie, l’agent s’abstient d’agir. Atteindre cet objectif exige d’étendre les techniques de vérification stratégique à des environnements ouverts, évolutifs et partiellement spécifiés, et d’étudier des notions de correction adaptées à une information incomplète. jobs.description: For this position we source for our sistercompany Troostwijk. About us Troostwijk and it's group TBAuctions are one of Europe’s leading networks for digital B2B auctions. We market machines, vehicles, equipment and other commercial assets, bringing sellers and buyers together through digital processes and personal support. What your day-to-day work will involve As an Account Manager, you will develop the French seller market and act as the main point of contact for new and existing sellers. You will build a profitable portfolio, develop long-term relationships based on trust and guide opportunities from the first conversation through to active auction business. The role combines remote work with regular travel and gives you direct influence on the development of our French market. You will receive professional support from our teams and work with modern tools that help you structure your pipeline, follow-ups and seller relationships. What this means in practice Identify, approach and acquire new sellers in the French market. Develop a profitable seller portfolio and build long-term relationships based on trust. Research companies and market opportunities and turn them into relevant conversations. Present our activities and value proposition clearly to business owners and potential sellers. Prepare meetings, understand seller needs and agree on clear next steps. Own negotiations and follow opportunities through to conversion. Keep pipeline, follow-ups and seller information structured with modern tools. Represent our company image and values in the market and coordinate closely with internal teams. What matters in this role We are looking for someone who enjoys building a market rather than only maintaining an existing portfolio. You should be comfortable creating your own pipeline, speaking confidently with business owners, handling rejection and staying focused until opportunities move forward. What you should bring Proven experience in sales, business development

jobs.description: At Veracyte , we offer exciting career opportunities for those interested in joining a pioneering team that is committed to transforming cancer care for patients across the globe. Working at Veracyte enables our employees to not only make a meaningful impact on the lives of patients, but to also learn and grow within a purpose driven environment. This is what we call the Veracyte way – it’s about how we work together, guided by our values, to give clinicians the insights they need to help patients make life-changing decisions. The Position: We are seeking a motivated and scientifically rigorous Bioinformatics Scientist II to contribute to the development of next-generation minimal residual disease (MRD) laboratory-developed tests (LDTs). This role will support assay development efforts through bioinformatics analysis, experimental design, data interpretation, and close collaboration with cross-functional teams. The ideal candidate is an early-career scientist with a strong foundation in genomics, bioinformatics, and next-generation sequencing (NGS). Candidates may be recent Ph.D. graduates or individuals with 1 to 3 years of postdoctoral or industry experience. The successful candidate will be a creative problem solver, critical thinker, and collaborative scientist who enjoys working at the interface of computational biology and laboratory assay development. We believe in a world where users, creators and enterprises manage their value with ownership and freedom. Our curiosity drives us to innovate, empowering individuals on a global scale. We believe change is constant and our team moves forward as one, with a culture of problem-solving where every employee is empowered and supported to challenge tradition and create solutions. Our mission is simple: to make self-custody accessible and give people the keys to their own financial futures. If you want to make a true impact, we want you to join us at Ledger. At Ledger, we’re proud to be the global platform for digital assets and Web3, with over 20% of the world’s crypto assets secured through our Ledger devices. Sinds afgelopen jaar zetten wij een propositie in de markt die daar tussenin zit: non-service uitzenden. jobs.description: Who are we and why should you join us? BetterHelp is on a mission to remove the traditional barriers to therapy and make mental health care more accessible to everyone. Founded in 2013, we are now the world’s largest online therapy service, providing affordable and convenient therapy across the globe. Our network of over 30,000 licensed therapists has helped millions of people take ownership of their mental health and change their lives forever. And we’re not stopping there – as the unmet need for mental health services continues to grow, BetterHelp is committed to being part of the solution. As a Data Science Extern at BetterHelp, you’ll join a diverse team of licensed clinicians, engineers, product pros, creatives, marketers, and business leaders who share a passion for expanding access to therapy. And as a mental health company, we take employee mental health just as seriously as we do our mission. We deeply invest in our team’s well-being and professional development, because we know that business and individual growth go hand-in-hand. At BetterHelp, you’ll carve your own path, make an immediate impact, and be challenged every day – with a supportive community behind you the whole way. What are we looking for? BetterHelp is looking for a Data Science Extern to help us scale and increase our impact. You will use data to drive insight into the product and business. The ideal candidate would have experience/exposure to analyzing large and complex data sets related to web products. You'll be doing plenty of data wrangling and post-hoc analysis, both to support product improvements, marketing efficiency, and business decisions. What will you do? Language Model Optimization: Engage in the refinement and enhancement of language models, including fine-tuning and retraining to meet specific requirements. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Actively collaborate with the product and development teams to conceptualize and design effective machine learning models and algorithms

Otoritas Jasa Keuangan (OJK) secara resmi mengeluarkan izin merger tiga usaha bank syariah tersebut pada 27 Januari 2021 melalui surat Nomor SR-3/PB.1/2021. Berikut ini adalah Lowongan Kerja PT Bank Syariah Indonesia Tbk. Komposisi pemegang saham BSI adalah: PT Bank Mandiri (Persero) Tbk 50,83%, PT Bank Negara Indonesia (Persero) Tbk 24,85%, PT Bank Rakyat Indonesia (Persero) Tbk 17,25%. Sisanya adalah pemegang saham yang masing-masing di bawah 5%. Penggabungan ini menyatukan kelebihan dari ketiga bank syariah tersebut, sehingga menghadirkan layanan yang lebih lengkap, jangkauan lebih luas, serta memiliki kapasitas permodalan yang lebih baik. Didukung sinergi dengan perusahaan serta komitmen pemerintah melalui Kementerian BUMN, BSI didorong untuk dapat bersaing di tingkat global. Lowongan Kerja PT Bank Syariah Indonesia Tbk Saat ini PT Bank Syariah Indonesia (BSI) membuka kesempatan untuk dapat bergabung bersama dengan posisi sebagai berikut: 1. Business Development Program (BDP) BDP adalah program pengembangan yang dirancang untuk mempersiapkan talenta terbaik menjadi professional syariah bankers yang kompeten dalam mendorong pertumbuhan bisnis Bank, mengelola hubungan dengan nasabah dan mengidentifikasi peluang bisnis serta akan ditempatkan di seluruh unit bisnis BSI di Kantor Jaringan. jobs.description: Kantor Pelayanan Pajak atau KPP adalah salah satu unit atau cabang dari Direktorat Jenderal Pajak di Indonesia. Kantor ini bertugas untuk memberikan pelayanan terkait perpajakan kepada wajib pajak yang berada di wilayahnya. Kantor Pelayanan Pajak Pratama biasanya melayani wajib pajak yang memiliki jenis usaha atau perorangan dengan volume transaksi yang lebih kecil dibandingkan dengan kantor pajak yang lebih besar seperti Kantor Pelayanan Pajak Besar. Penerimaan Pegawai Pemerintah Non Pegawai Negeri (PPNPN) KPP Pratama. Kantor Pelayanan Pajak Pratama biasanya melayani wajib pajak yang memiliki jenis usaha atau perorangan dengan volume transaksi yang lebih kecil dibandingkan dengan kantor pajak yang lebih besar seperti Kantor Pelayanan Pajak Besar. Mereka juga melakukan pemeriksaan pajak untuk memastikan kepatuhan wajib pajak terhadap aturan perpajakan. Kantor Pelayanan Pajak Pratama ini biasanya tersebar di berbagai wilayah di seluruh Indonesia untuk memudahkan wajib pajak dalam mengakses layanan perpajakan tanpa harus pergi ke kantor pajak yang lebih besar. jobs.description: Badan Amil Zakat Nasional (BAZNAS) adalah badan resmi dan satu-satunya yang dibentuk oleh pemerintah berdasarkan Keputusan Presiden RI No. 8 Tahun 2001 yang memiliki tugas dan fungsi menghimpun dan menyalurkan zakat, infak, dan sedekah (ZIS) pada tingkat nasional. Berikut ini lowongan kerja Badan Amil Zakat Nasional (BAZNAS). Lahirnya Undang-Undang Nomor 23 Tahun 2011 tentang Pengelolaan Zakat semakin mengukuhkan peran BAZNAS sebagai lembaga yang berwenang melakukan pengelolaan zakat secara nasional. Dalam UU tersebut, BAZNAS dinyatakan sebagai lembaga pemerintah nonstruktural yang bersifat mandiri dan bertanggung jawab kepada Presiden melalui Menteri Agama. Dalam mengelola zakat, BAZNAS menerapkan prinsip 3A, yakni Aman Syari, Aman Regulasi, dan Aman NKRI. Aman Syari artinya pengelolaan zakat yang dilaksanakan BAZNAS harus selaras dengan koridor hukum syari. Pengelolaan zakat harus selaras dan tidak boleh bertentangan dengan sumber hukum Islam, Al-Quran dan Sunnah. Aman Regulasi artinya bahwa pengelolaan zakat harus memperhatikan rambu-rambu peraturan hukum dan perundangan.
